description: This file contains TypeScript code for managing skills within a UI. It defines data types, state management functions, and asynchronous operations related to skill search, update, installation, and detail loading. The functions include handling requests to external services, updating the application state, and error handling.

methods.name: function setSkillMessage(state: SkillsState, key: string, message?: SkillMessage) { setSkillMessage
methods.description: Updates the skillMessages record within the state with a new message or removes it if undefined.

methods.name: function getErrorMessage(err: unknown) { getErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object into a string message.

methods.name: export function setClawHubSearchQuery(state: SkillsState, query: string) { setClawHubSearchQuery
methods.description: Sets the current ClawHub search query and resets related state properties.

methods.name: export async function loadSkills(state: SkillsState, options?: LoadSkillsOptions) { loadSkills
methods.description: Fetches the status report of skills from the client API and updates the state.

methods.name: export function updateSkillEdit(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, value: string) { updateSkillEdit
methods.description: Updates the skillEdits record with a new value for a specific skill key.

methods.name: export async function updateSkillEnabled(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, enabled: boolean)/ updateSkillEnabled
methods.description: Requests enabling or disabling a skill, then reloads skills and sets success/error message.

methods.name: export async function saveSkillApiKey(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string) { saveSkillApiKey
methods.description: Saves the API key for a skill and reloads skills, with success/error messaging.

methods.name: export async function installSkill( installSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill from given parameters and updates the skill list, with success/error messaging.

methods.name: export async function searchClawHub(state: SkillsState, query: string) { searchClawHub
methods.description: Searches ClawHub for skills matching a query and updates results, handling errors.

methods.name: export async function loadClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { loadClawHubDetail
methods.description: Loads detailed information for a specific ClawHub skill by slug.

methods.name: export function closeClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState) { closeClawHubDetail
methods.description: Resets ClawHub detail related state properties.

methods.name: export async function installFromClawHub(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { installFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a skill from ClawHub by slug and updates the UI with success/error message.
